    cur = ""
    for w in text.split():

        extra = len(w) + (1 if cur else 0)

        if len(cur) + extra >= width:
            lines.append(cur)
            cur = w  # Start fresh with the new word

            cur += f"{w} "
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines
